ToneOptions.Label: Authoritative & Precise
ToneOptions.FullPhrase: Maintain an authoritative, precise, and technically rigorous tone suitable for infrastructure design.

ToneOptions.Label: Instructive & Clear
ToneOptions.FullPhrase: Adopt an instructive, clear, and unambiguous tone, guiding implementation with clarity.

ToneOptions.Label: Concise & Actionable
ToneOptions.FullPhrase: Employ a concise, direct, and actionable tone, focusing on practical implementation details.

ToneOptions.Label: Comprehensive & Detailed
ToneOptions.FullPhrase: Utilize a comprehensive, detailed, and thorough tone, leaving no ambiguity for implementers.

GoalOptions.Label: Enable Cloud Deployment
GoalOptions.Text: This document aims to provide Junior Devs and DevOps with all necessary technical specifications and architectural decisions to successfully deploy, configure, and operate the new cloud infrastructure component. Success means they can implement the design without significant blockers or further architectural consultation.

GoalOptions.Label: Ensure Operational Readiness
GoalOptions.Text: The primary goal is to ensure the cloud infrastructure design is fully understood and actionable for operational teams. This includes clear instructions for monitoring, logging, and incident response, enabling robust day-2 operations and minimizing support escalations.

GoalOptions.Label: Facilitate Code Implementation
GoalOptions.Text: This document serves as the definitive guide for Junior Devs to translate architectural concepts into working code for cloud resource provisioning and configuration. It should provide sufficient detail on APIs, SDKs, and desired state to enable efficient and correct implementation.

GoalOptions.Label: Standardize Infrastructure Patterns
GoalOptions.Text: The objective is to standardize the approach to deploying this specific cloud infrastructure pattern across the organization. This document will ensure consistency, reusability, and adherence to best practices for all future deployments of similar components.

CriteriaOptions.Label: Technical Feasibility & Performance
Criteria: All specified cloud resources and configurations are technically feasible within the chosen cloud provider's limits.
The design meets defined performance SLAs (e.g., latency, throughput) under expected load conditions.
The proposed solution demonstrates high availability and fault tolerance as per architectural requirements.
The design incorporates efficient resource utilization to optimize cloud spend without compromising performance.

CriteriaOptions.Label: Operational Readiness & Maintainability
Criteria: The design includes clear specifications for logging, monitoring, and alerting for all critical components.
Deployment and rollback procedures are clearly defined and automated where possible.
The solution is designed for easy troubleshooting and diagnosis by DevOps teams.
Documentation for day-2 operations, including runbooks and escalation paths, is complete and accessible.

CriteriaOptions.Label: Security & Compliance Adherence
Criteria: All cloud resources are configured with the principle of least privilege for access control.
Data at rest and in transit is encrypted according to organizational security policies.
The design incorporates network segmentation and firewall rules to minimize attack surface.
The solution adheres to relevant industry compliance standards (e.g., SOC2, ISO 27001) for cloud deployments.
